segments.name: MedTech
segments.description: Develops and manufactures cardiovascular, orthopaedics, surgery and vision products used by physicians, hospitals, eye care professionals and healthcare systems in acute and elective procedures.
segments.evidence: The MedTech segment develops and manufactures a broad portfolio of products used in cardiovascular, orthopaedics, surgery, and vision supporting physicians, hospitals, eye care professionals and healthcare systems across a wide range of acute and elective procedures.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by retailers, wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, healthcare professionals and eye care professionals for prescription medicines and medical devices.
revenueModel.evidence: Medicines in this segment are distributed directly to retailers, wholesalers, distributors, hospitals and healthcare professionals for prescription use.
